title: German client meeting with code-switching and a changed decision

turns.text: Wir gehen mit der Region Frankfurt, das ist decided.
turns.translation: We are going with the Frankfurt region, that's decided.

turns.text: Super, dann planen wir die Migration entsprechend.
turns.translation: Great, then we'll plan the migration accordingly.

turns.text: Wobei, unser Security Team meinte gestern, wir sollten eventuell Zürich nehmen wegen eines Schweizer Kunden.
turns.translation: Although, our security team said yesterday we should perhaps take Zurich because of a Swiss customer.

turns.text: Aber das ist noch nicht final.

mustInclude: Flags that the hosting region is no longer decided: Frankfurt was called decided, then Zurich was raised as a possibility
Notes the migration owner is still not named
checkpoints.ideal: Check: region is open again (Frankfurt vs possibly Zurich for the Swiss customer); pause migration planning until security confirms, and name an owner.
